thread:
Omar: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a tiny ingress "bridgelet" to accept deprecated API shapes and emit the new runtime contract. Opt-in per-tenant flag. Main goal: low-risk, observable stopgap while clients migrate.
Lina: Opt-in is good. Two big concerns: streaming frame semantics and cache key churn.
Tess: I built a small PoC (WASM) that remaps header+first-frame and forwards the rest. Median overhead ~1ms; p99 ~5ms on our small bench for 3KB chunks.
Omar: Ownership question: gateway owns faster rollout but creates cross-team ops. Runtime plugin centralizes ownership but needs more internal testing. Proposal: bridgelet at edge as opt-in; if adoption >20% move mappings upstream.
Lina: We should header-gate (X-Compat: legacy->current) and add X-Bridgelet-Applied when successful. Also a mode header X-Compat-Mode: best-effort|strict. best-effort forwards original with warn header on failure; strict returns 422.
Tess: Pseudocode from PoC:
```
if header == "X-Compat: legacy->current":
  if stream:
    map_first_frame_meta() -> new_header_frame
    for f in rest: emit(map_frame_or_passthrough(f))
  else:
    mapped = transform(json_body)
    if mapped.ok: set header X-Bridgelet-Applied and forward(mapped)
    else if mode == strict: return 422
    else: set header X-Bridgelet-Warn and forward(original)
```
Omar: Telemetry: bridgelet_invoked, bridgelet_latency_ms, bridgelet_stream_rewrites, bridgelet_error_rate. Tag by tenant_id and route and include trace_id in logs.
Lina: Cache key compatibility: compute canonical_cache_key(raw_input, stable_schema_hash) in the bridgelet and emit X-Canonical-Key so downstream caches can use it. Monitor canonical_cache_miss_delta.
Tess: Tool arg renames are sensitive. Provide aliasing in the tool registry rather than doing heavy semantic changes in the bridgelet. For ambiguous renames tombstone original to S3 if tenant debug enabled and add X-Tombstone-Pointer.
Omar: Security: no eval, no template execution. All mappings must be declarative and signed. sec-bot: please run automated mapping audits and enforce redaction-before-log.
sec-bot: Ack. Will run audit and block mappings that touch PII without manual review. RBAC: only platform-release and tenant-ops can toggle the tenant opt-in.
Lina: Rollout: internal dev tenants (4) -> early partners (10) -> 50 tenants -> broad. Canary gates: bridgelet_error_rate, p99 latency delta, canonical_cache_miss_delta, gateway_cpu. Rollback: flip tenant flag off or remove bridgelet from route.
Tess: I'll publish the WASM PoC + perf numbers and a small circuit-breaker sketch (ETA 48h). Omar: I'll draft the rollout playbook and canonical key spec (ETA 24h). Lina: you'll own RBAC + alert tuning (ETA 24h).
Omar: Action items noted. Revisit after artifacts. :white_check_mark:
